mcqs.question: On August 1, 2026, which event is scheduled at Bhogapuram in Vizianagaram district?
options: The Prime Minister will inaugurate Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport and projects worth more than ₹17,900 crore
The Prime Minister will inaugurate only the ASIP Semiconductor Project worth ₹460 crore
The Prime Minister will inaugurate Kurnool-IV REZ Phase-I and the Tadipatri Bypass
The Prime Minister will inaugurate the Talliki Vandanam Scheme for Class 1 to Class 12 students
mcqs.explanation: The Prime Minister is scheduled to inaugurate Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram and projects worth more than ₹17,900 crore on August 1, 2026. The ASIP project, Kurnool-IV REZ Phase-I and Talliki Vandanam are separate components or initiatives, not the complete inauguration event described here.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about Bhogapuram airport is incorrect?
options: The airport is being developed under the greenfield PPP model at a cost of more than ₹5,640 crore.
Its planned capacity is about 6 million passengers per year.
The airport will use AI-enabled operations, biometric processing and an Airport Predictive Operations Centre.
The airport includes a 10 MW solar plant and its design is inspired by Chuttilu cottages and Araku Valley.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the one mentioning a 10 MW solar plant. Bhogapuram airport is planned with a 5 MW solar plant; its greenfield PPP model, capacity of about 6 million passengers per year and technology features are correctly stated.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Under the Talliki Vandanam Scheme, the annual assistance is ₹15,000 per student, with ₹2,000 deducted for school maintenance, sanitation and hygiene.
Statement B: The scheme covers students from Class 1 to Class 12, including Intermediate, in government, aided, private and residential schools.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The scheme provides ₹15,000 per student annually, including a ₹2,000 deduction for specified school-related purposes, and covers Class 1 to Class 12 including Intermediate across the listed types of schools.

mcqs.question:
With reference to eligibility under the Talliki Vandanam Scheme, consider the following statements:
1. The income limit is below ₹10,000 per month in rural areas and below ₹12,000 per month in urban areas.
2. The land criterion permits wet land up to 3 acres and dry land up to 10 acres.
3. The electricity-consumption criterion is below 500 units per month.
mcqs.explanation: Exactly two statements are correct: Statements 1 and 2. The electricity criterion is below 300 units per month, not below 500 units, making Statement 3 incorrect.
